units.source_text: 我正是‘为爱春郊宿一宵’。”

en.t: I am indeed one who spent a night in the spring fields for love.
That was the gist of it.

units.source_text: 两位女公子不知这回信应该如何写法，不能报命，心甚烦乱。

en.t: The two young ladies did not know how this reply ought to be written, and unable to answer as instructed, they were deeply troubled.

units.source_text: 那老侍女说：“这等时候，如果看得太认真，回信拖延太久，反而有失体统。”

en.t: The old attendant said, "At times like this, if you take it too seriously and delay the reply too long, it will instead be improper."

units.source_text: 大女公子便叫二女公子执笔。

en.t: The elder young lady then had the younger young lady take up the brush.
